publicFacts: Chart and series setters are fluent; color, fill, line, font and palette mutations produce new style values.
ColorRGBA and Color.setA use channels from 0 to 255, including alpha. Default alpha is 255.
Axis.setInterval accepts optional start/end, animation and stopAxisAfter fields. An omitted endpoint is retained; stopAxisAfter defaults to true.
ChartXY exposes identical axisX/xAxis and axisY/yAxis aliases.
Heatmap grid dimensions and data order must be explicit. Grid matrices differ from scrolling-grid sample batches.
Subscription tokens allow individual event handlers to be removed without disposing the chart.
openTestDataContracts: DataSet schema keys are arbitrary column names, with typed storage and optional progressive/automatic coordinates.
OpenTest uses xValues as Float64Array, source yValues and rendered renderYValues as separate Float32Array or Float64Array columns.
An automatic coordinate ignores explicit input for that column. start denotes the first coordinate in the incoming batch. A step-only append continues from the preceding coordinate.
clear resets the logical sample index and automatic-coordinate continuation.
Fixed-capacity retention preserves the latest complete rows. Capacity changes preserve retained order and the next logical sample index.
A replacement series can share an existing data set. Disposing one series must not dispose that data set.
DataSet.readBack range keys identify a progressive data column; range endpoints are coordinate values, not sample indexes.
Non-finite source values remain available for copying. Rendering uses separate gaps at the same coordinates.
implementationChoices: A logical sample counter is independent of the physical ring write position.
Oversized batches copy only the retained tail without allocating per-sample objects.
Logical-order column snapshots are cached by revision for rendering; public readBack returns owned arrays.
Each data append emits one change event and advances one revision.
Palette lookup uses sorted steps and binary search, with explicit interpolation and non-finite fallback colors.

validation.scope: Core unit contracts only; application integration and end-to-end measurements are separate.
